## Setup checklist
1. Reuses the same "Chatwoot API" httpHeaderAuth credential the other whizz-*-conversation-message workflows already have configured.
2. Whizz calls this at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-delete-conversation-message with body {id, messageId} (id = the Chatwoot conversation id, messageId = the message to delete) and expects back {ok:true} on success or {error} on failure.
3. IMPORTANT: this deletes the message from Chatwoot's own record only — it does NOT unsend it from WhatsApp. WhatsApp's Business Platform has no API for "delete for everyone"; once a message is delivered to the customer's phone, it stays there regardless of what happens here. The frontend's confirmation copy says this explicitly — don't let it drift to implying a true unsend if this workflow's wording changes.
4. Chatwoot's DELETE /conversations/{id}/messages/{message_id} endpoint is the standard REST shape for this, but hasn't been verified against a live call from this account — if it 404s or behaves differently, check Chatwoot's current API docs for this account's version and adjust the URL/method below.
